inputSpecification: The model uses RGB-channels from true orthophoto, LiDAR DSM and LiDAR DEM. Input is provided as a 5-channel image with 25 cm resolution (RGB + DSM + DEM).
outputSpecification: The model generates a two-channel logit map per pixel (representing background and building classes)
trainingDataOrigin: The model has been trained with remote sensing data from different parts of Finland collected by the NLS.
